tweets.author: @AFpost
tweets.text:
Data shows the Black fertility rate dropping by 0.084 to 1.43, and the Asian fertility rate dropping by 0.025 to 1.203.

At the current rate, Blacks and Asians could hit an approximate 1.0 fertility rate, leaving their populations set to halve over time without improvement.

tweets.author: @MoreBirths
tweets.text:
A high fertility group that gets little notice is the Pentecostals of Eastern Europe, with large populations in Romania, Ukraine and Russia.

With a fertility rate twice the local average, they stand out in a region that is depopulating due to low birthrates and outmigration.
